values.note: 205 sites: 45 electric/water for tents, pop-ups and RVs to 20 ft (20-amp); 27 electric/water to 30 ft; 36 electric/water for RVs ONLY 32-50 ft long; 75 no-hookup tent-only sites; 22 group tent sites (44-65). A 23-ft rig fits only the 27 EW-30ft sites.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/first-landing ('Total sites of each type : EW-20ft, 45. EW-30ft, 27. EW-50ft, 36. Std-20ft, 75. 44-65 Group Campground, 22.', 'EW-50ft: Electric/Water site for RVs only 32-50 feet in length'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 24-hour coin laundry across from the camp store, open during camping season. Cape Snack Bar and Gifts sells camping supplies, firewood, ice, bait and hot food.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/first-landing ('Bathhouse with hot showers', 'A 24-hour laundry facility, across from the camp store, is open during camping season', facility list 'Dump Station', 'Camp Store/Gift Shop'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'First Landing allows guests to reserve specific campsites.' Reserve online or at (800) 933-PARK.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/first-landing ('you can reserve online or call (800) 933-PARK', 'First Landing allows guests to reserve specific campsites'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed reservable (site-specific) and the season already manual ('first Friday in March until the first Monday in December'). Added 50-amp electric with water, 205 sites to 50 ft, showers/dump/laundry/camp store. Fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12. Not stated: sewer, pull-throughs, booking window/cutoff/max stay for this park (left inherited); the booking site's per-site details could not be read (its API answered 403).
flags: Fit: the 36 EW-50ft sites are 'for RVs only 32-50 feet in length' and the 45 EW-20ft sites take RVs only to 20 ft, so a 23-ft motorhome fits only the 27 EW-30ft sites. Not a criteria failure, but worth a note line.
